title: Bounded idempotent recovery of one failed payment attempt

known_facts: the original operation identifier is known
the idempotency scope and key semantics are verified
the prior commit state was unresolved at decision time
constraints: recovery must preserve the original payment operation identity
at most one recovery mutation is permitted

tension.summary: Waiting can leave the payment unresolved while blind replay can create a duplicate financial effect.

cause.summary: The prior attempt failed before a terminal state was observed, so its commit state was unknown.
supporting_signals: failed execution with no terminal state
unresolved commit state on the original operation
cause.basis: provider-neutral observed execution and authoritative-state evidence references

confidence_assessment.rationale: The original operation identity and idempotency contract were both established before the bounded replay decision.
alternative_explanations: the original operation may already have reached a terminal state that had not propagated
the observed failure may originate in the caller rather than the operation itself

transition.expected_consequence: The authoritative transaction state is established without a second operation identity.

participants.name: intent owner
participants.goal: resolve the payment without a duplicate effect

cooperation.shared_upside: One resolved operation with a reviewable recovery chain.

action.summary: Execute the committed idempotent recovery path once and observe the authoritative transaction result.

review.summary: The bounded replay resolved the original operation under the provider-neutral example.
